comparison.objective: Uncap a spray can and coat a plaque while limiting overspray.
comparison.physical_skill: Remove a cap, hold and actuate a can, and control nozzle aim and coating coverage.
comparison.success_condition: Required plaque coverage is achieved within the overspray limit, with the cap parked and can safely stabilized.
comparison.reason: Coating deposition and overspray control do not test physical size-based separation of loose bodies through a screen.
